items.title: AMD, Intel, Meta, Warner Bros., Moderna, Grail, Strategy, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks advanced Monday as oil prices eased and investors turned their attention to this week’s United National General Assembly for potential signs of resolution to the conflict in Iran.  Technology stocks, and artificial-intelligence stocks in particular, traded higher after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with China’s vice premier He Lifeng and said the pair had agreed to an AI dialogue.  Micron Technology  added 2.7% and  Marvell Technology  rose 5.4%.

items.title: Moderna To Present Additional Data From Key Melanoma Trial At ESMO Congress – Retail Says ‘Breakout Is Getting Hard To Ignore’
items.summary: Moderna will showcase detailed melanoma results for Intismeran at ESMO, alongside data and trial updates exploring the personalized therapy in pancreatic and lung cancers.

items.title: Moderna Surges 9% as Phase 3 Melanoma Data Wins Presidential Symposium Slot; Merck and BioNTech Edge Higher
items.summary: A coveted Presidential Symposium slot at Europe's top oncology congress just sent Moderna shares flying 9%, but the actual Phase 3 melanoma data remains unseen. Here is why the scheduling alone is moving markets and what it signals about what that dataset might show.
